scope.workload: Unchanged original setup body, three warmup-labelled and 237 measured-labelled tests. Complete command includes all 240, fixture startup, runner, browser and observed shutdown.
scope.comparison: Same Flashwright/native baseline with sampling on/off; no Playwright capture or optimization in this diagnostic.
scope.browserPolicy: Existing renderer reuse, classic uncapped frames, early idle deadline and lazy VAAPI discovery. Locator source cache and native script cache off. Original public launch arguments retained before explicit private feature additions.
scope.sampling: 500000 ns inherited user-mode task-clock sampling, user IP/callchains capped at 64 stack entries plus context marker; six opening affinity CPUs, four-core quota, 8 GiB memory, no swap, Nice10.
scope.resourceScope: Owner cgroup deltas include sampler cost; sampled descendants exclude the sampler parent. Original watchdog confirms exit without cleanup signals or surviving observed descendants.

symbolVerification.scope: One sampled address per nonempty ELF symbol alias group, including caller frames; not every address or an independent unwind check.

method.mapping: Fresh read/execute mmap control binds hashed binary to its actual mapped device and inode; no mapped bytes executed. Original perf fork/exec/mmap records, latest covering mapping, ELF executable PT_LOAD offsets, sized STT_FUNC/IFUNC ranges.
method.aliases: Keep all overlapping/folded aliases. A category matches only if every alias in that symbol group matches one of its terms; one sample counts at most once per category. Categories overlap and must not be summed.
method.instructionAddresses: Leaf IP unchanged; caller return addresses minus one. First duplicated leaf frame omitted. Perf context markers preserved as counts.
method.denominator: Every browser-family sample remains accounted, including anonymous/JIT, external libraries and unresolved native ranges. Ancestry may include native callers of external/anonymous leaves. Thread names are kernel COMM labels, not unique process roles.
method.independentSymbolCheck: One actual sampled address per resolved symbol group, leaf or caller, checked against LLVM; not all addresses or independent unwind validity.

decisions: Explicit retirement-collection ancestry is a small part of sampled browser CPU in this setup workload. Prioritize other repeated costs before further GC-policy experiments. This is not an upper bound on GC or proof of finalizer drainage.

Frame scheduling, including callbacks that report no produced frame, and protocol transport/conversion recur across both worker counts and blocks. Investigate their source ownership before selecting a new mechanism; named ancestry does not prove the work is unnecessary.
Do not change final acceptance workloads or claim a new speedup. The prior suite-size result still shows startup-only tuning is insufficient.
limitations: Four profiled captures and four controls, two reversed blocks; no confidence interval or final performance/resource acceptance.
Fixed software sampling excludes kernel instruction attribution and can miss short-lived tasks. Nominal sample-period sums are not exact CPU time.
Callchains are bounded and may stop early; missing ancestors are not evidence of absence. Positive categories can overlap.
Mapping reconstruction does not observe unmaps or model PID generations. Later recorded replacement mappings override earlier ones; stale unrecorded ranges remain a limitation.
No JIT symbol names, JS URL attribution, native debug inlining, application-operation windows, exclusive request ownership or critical-path decomposition.
Opening affinity was fixed and launch policy verified; sampler does not dynamically follow affinity expansion.
Initial analysis stopped before decoding because Python mmap defaults to shared while the control expected private. Corrected to explicit MAP_PRIVATE; no workload rerun or excluded capture.
